entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
.....
 Through: Mr. Deepak Singh Thaku
 versus
 State Nct Of Delhi And Anr .....
 Through: Mr. Ajay Vikram Singh, Ap
 State.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan
 Order

The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No. 709/2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at Police Station Punjabi Bagh and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement.
2. Mr. Deepak Singh Thakur, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the entire payment has been made by the petitioners to the respondent no.2, in terms of the settlement.

However, the respondent no.2/complainant is not coming forward for quashing of the present FIR.
3.
In view of the above, issue notice.
Mr. Ajay Vikram Singh, learned APP for the State accepts notice.

4. On petitioners taking steps, notice be issued to the respondent no.2, by all permissible modes,
returnable on 06.04.2026.
